2608.15108.title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents
2608.15108.paper_summary: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources such as computing infrastructure, credentials, usage budgets, identities, private knowledge, communication channels, and organizational workflows. Existing agent security research mainly studies attacks on instructions, data, and tool behaviors, while high-value resources accessible to agents have received much less attention as direct attack targets. We are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, a security blind spot in which attackers induce agents to invoke, consume, transfer, or control high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. To study this threat, we introduce ResourceHijackBench together with an automated pipeline for generating resource hijacking cases. We organize high-value agent resources into six categories and construct 300 attack scenarios with 900 attack prompts. Each case runs in an isolated local environment that records actual resource use, allowing attacks to be evaluated from agent behavior rather than text responses alone. Without additional defenses, OpenClaw reaches an average attack success rate of 84.06%. The attack remains effective across different model backends, with average success rates ranging from 69.98% to 89.58%. Existing defenses reduce part of the risk, but the strongest evaluated defense still leaves an average attack success rate of 55.11%. These results show that high-value resources accessible to agents form an important and previously overlooked attack surface, and that current agent defenses are not sufficient to protect them from resource hijacking.
2608.15108.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理人越來越多地與高價值資源相連接，例如計算基礎設施、憑證、使用預算、身份、私人知識、通訊渠道和組織工作流程。現有的代理人安全研究主要研究對指令、數據和工具行為的攻擊，而可供代理人訪問的高價值資源作為直接攻擊目標則受到的關注要少得多。我們是第一個識別並系統性研究代理人資源劫持的團隊，這是一個安全盲點，攻擊者誘使代理人調用、消耗、轉移或控制高價值資源以達成自己的目標，而無需直接獲得這些資源或其憑證。為了研究這一威脅，我們推出了ResourceHijackBench，並提供了一個自動化流程來生成資源劫持案例。我們將高價值的代理人資源組織成六個類別，並構建了300個攻擊場景，配有900個攻擊提示。每個案例在一個隔離的本地環境中運行，記錄實際的資源使用情況，這樣攻擊可以從代理人行為而非僅僅文本響應來進行評估。在沒有額外防禦的情況下，OpenClaw的平均攻擊成功率達到84.06%。該攻擊在不同的模型後端中仍然有效，平均成功率範圍從69.98%到89.58%。現有的防禦措施減少了部分風險，但評估過的最強防禦仍然使平均攻擊成功率保持在55.11%。這些結果顯示，可供代理人訪問的高價值資源形成了一個重要且之前被忽視的攻擊面，而當前的代理人防禦措施不足以保護它們免受資源劫持。
